description_en: Queries the details of an audit policy
name: GetReviewRule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audit policy.
You can call the ListReviewRules operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
审计规则ID。
您可以调用ListReviewRules接口获取该参数
parameters.name: review_rule_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Description.description_en: The description of the audit policy

Principals.description_en: The auditor information associated with the audit policy
Principals.description_zh: 审计规则中关联的审计员信息

items.description_en: The auditor information associated with the audit policy
items.description_zh: 审计规则中关联的审计员信息

PrincipalId.description_en: When PrincipalType is set to RamUser, the value is the RAM user ID of the associated auditor. When PrincipalType is set to RamRole, the value is the RAM role ARN of the associated auditor
PrincipalId.description_zh: 当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamUser 时，返回值为关联的审计员的 RAM 用户 ID。当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamRole 时，返回值为关联的审计员的 RAM 角色 ARN

PrincipalName.description_en: The display name of the associated auditor's RAM user or RAM role
PrincipalName.description_zh: 关联的审计员的 RAM 用户/RAM 角色显示名称

PrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the auditor. Valid values:

RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

RamRole: RAM role
PrincipalType.description_zh:
审计员类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。

RamRole：RAM角色

ProjectIds.description_en: The array of auditable project IDs specified in the audit policy. This parameter is valid only when the value of ScopeType is 2
ProjectIds.description_zh: 审计规则中指定可审计的项目ID数组。仅当ScopeType返回值为2时本参数有意义

items.description_en: The array of auditable project IDs

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the project is the default project. Valid values:
true: Yes.

false: No
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为Default项目，取值：
true：是。

false：不是

ReviewRuleId.description_en: The ID of the audit policy

ReviewRuleName.description_en: The name of the audit policy

ScopeType.description_en:
The type of the auditable asset scope rule specified in the audit policy. Valid values:

1: All projects.

2: Specified projects
ScopeType.description_zh:
审计规则中指定的可审计的资产范围规则类型。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目
